final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(link_to_major),''),'__missing__') AS k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM member GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT k, c, CAST(c AS REAL)/(SELECT SUM(c) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.c) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_of_selected, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
